title: Human wellbeing and development
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:50Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point covers measuring development with GDP and HDI at a Year 11 depth, while the new point defines wellbeing and development as a process, including safety and freedom, for Year 10, so it is related but not the same idea.

draft.title: Wellbeing and development
card: the quality of people's lives. It covers health, education, income, safety and freedom.
the process of improving human wellbeing over time. It is a change, not a fixed state.
Wellbeing has many parts, so no single thing, such as income, can describe it fully.
A place develops when more of its people can live long, healthy, safe lives, learn, and make choices about their futures.
draft.remember: Wellbeing is how good life is for people. Development is the process of making it better.

a.q: Which of these describes development, rather than wellbeing?
opts: A town builds a clinic and a school, and lives improve
People in a town have good health and feel safe
Children in a town can read and write well
Adults in a town are free to choose their work
a.why: Development is a process of change that improves lives, and building a clinic and a school is such a change. The other options describe conditions of wellbeing at one point in time, so they are not the process itself.
a.clue: Look for the option that describes a change over time.

b.q: A village in Tanzania gets a new bore for clean water. Fewer children get sick and more of them attend school. How is this best described?
opts: Development, because it improved several parts of wellbeing
Wellbeing only, because the village had no change
Development, because the village's income must have risen
Wellbeing only, because health is the whole of wellbeing
b.why: The bore is a change that improved health and education, which are parts of wellbeing, so this is development. Income was not mentioned, and wellbeing covers more than health.
b.clue: Ask whether something changed, and how many parts of life it touched.

a.best: A town builds a clinic and a school, and lives improve

b.best: Development, because it improved several parts of wellbeing
